page.alert: Opus audio, as in WebM, Ogg and most YouTube streams, and H264 without B-frames, VP8, VP9 or AV1 video no larger than the requested quality are sent as they are, using far less CPU. Opus audio is re-encoded when its average bitrate goes more than 25% above the one of the audio parameters, so VBR files are sent as they are. FFmpeg parameters on a track turn this off for that track.
